74868b1d7444: [5, {"length_scale": 0.95, "model": "en_GB-northern_english_male-medium", "pitch": 0.88}, {"length": 1.08, "lufs": -23, "noise": 0.55, "pitch": 0.98}, "I was a junior caretaker the night it started, fifty years back. 0270d807627b: [5, {"length_scale": 0.95, "model": "en_GB-northern_english_male-medium", "pitch": 0.88}, {"length": 1.0, "lufs": -18, "noise": 0.667, "pitch": 1.0}, "I\u2019ve watched that tower ever since. If you need something, Kringer, you come to me."]
a42ee3fb7d6c: [5, {"length_scale": 1.0, "model": "en_GB-cori-high"}, {"length": 1.0, "lufs": -18, "noise": 0.667, "pitch": 1.0}, "Harrow unhooks a heavy ring from his belt and twists a brass key free."]
2220f747926a: [5, {"length_scale": 0.95, "model": "en_GB-northern_english_male-medium", "pitch": 0.88}, {"length": 1.0, "lufs": -18, "noise": 0.667, "pitch": 1.0}, "Opens most doors in the east and west wings. You never had it, understand?"]
19df36e666d9: [5, {"length_scale": 1.0, "model": "en_GB-cori-high"}, {"length": 1.0, "lufs": -18, "noise": 0.667, "pitch": 1.0}, "He presses it into your palm and walks away without waiting for an answer."]
27186359d156: [5, {"length_scale": 1.0, "model": "en_GB-cori-high"}, {"length": 1.0, "lufs": -18, "noise": 0.667, "pitch": 1.0}, "It is early afternoon. The bell will toll again tonight; everyone knows it, and everyone is pretending not to. You have until dusk, and time for two leads, not three."]
4a5a6076b26f: [5, {"length_scale": 1.0, "model": "en_GB-cori-high"}, {"length": 1.0, "lufs": -18, "noise": 0.667, "pitch": 1.0}, "Harrow\u2019s warning sits in your pocket like a small cold stone."]
341d6f8bd561: [5, {"length_scale": 1.0, "model": "en_GB-cori-high"}, {"length": 1.0, "lufs": -18, "noise": 0.667, "pitch": 1.0}, "Across the courtyard Mirela catches your eye and taps her wrist, once: time."]
53fa2f3b3045: [5, {"length_scale": 1.0, "model": "en_GB-cori-high"}, {"length": 1.0, "lufs": -18, "noise": 0.667, "pitch": 1.0}, "Mirela is waiting behind the greenhouses with a map of the castle and a long column of numbers: the times the bell has rung."]
78ea1206af2d: [5, {"length_scale": 0.95, "model": "en_GB-jenny_dioco-medium"}, {"length": 1.0, "lufs": -18, "noise": 0.667, "pitch": 1.0}, "It\u2019s speeding up. At this rate the whole castle is asleep in four days."]
8d5c9a2da59d: [5, {"length_scale": 0.95, "model": "en_GB-jenny_dioco-medium"}, {"length": 1.0, "lufs": -18, "noise": 0.667, "pitch": 1.0}, "I have a plan, and you won\u2019t like it. I found a counter-spell in an old book that can break metal like this. We take the bell."]
94cdf1271fbd: [5, {"length_scale": 0.95, "model": "en_GB-jenny_dioco-medium"}, {"length": 1.0, "lufs": -18, "noise": 0.667, "pitch": 1.0}, "But I don\u2019t know what lies under that tower. I only know I can\u2019t watch one more person fall asleep."]
874d42dc7fbd: [5, {"length_scale": 1.0, "model": "en_GB-cori-high"}, {"length": 1.0, "lufs": -18, "noise": 0.667, "pitch": 1.0}, "Mirela bites her lip. Then, reluctantly, she nods."]
8bab673d4e3a: [5, {"length_scale": 0.95, "model": "en_GB-jenny_dioco-medium"}, {"length": 1.0, "lufs": -18, "noise": 0.667, "pitch": 1.0}, "Fine. But if there\u2019s nothing else by tonight, we take the bell. No more talking."]
49a139f9dcdd: [5, {"length_scale": 1.0, "model": "en_GB-cori-high"}, {"length": 1.0, "lufs": -18, "noise": 0.667, "pitch": 1.0}, "She folds the map into her pocket, and you realise she was relieved. She never wanted to be the one deciding."]
af8179a30070: [5, {"length_scale": 1.0, "model": "en_GB-cori-high"}, {"length": 1.07, "lufs": -18, "noise": 0.6, "pitch": 1.0}, "She folds up the map, and her eyes are hard."]
ba3b7336a179: [5, {"length_scale": 0.95, "model": "en_GB-jenny_dioco-medium"}, {"length": 1.1, "lufs": -20, "noise": 0.75, "pitch": 1.0, "vibrato": "vibrato=f=5.5:d=0.18"}, "I\u2019ll do it with you or without you, Kringer."]
e0c234bdceb7: [5, {"length_scale": 1.0, "model": "en_GB-cori-high"}, {"length": 1.07, "lufs": -18, "noise": 0.6, "pitch": 1.0}, "She walks away and leaves you standing between the greenhouses."]
16813d32211e: [5, {"length_scale": 1.0, "model": "en_GB-cori-high"}, {"length": 1.0, "lufs": -18, "noise": 0.667, "pitch": 1.0}, "The archive lies three flights beneath the kitchens: shelves to the ceiling, dust that glows in lantern light, a smell of old paper and cold stone. 45481983beca: [5, {"length_scale": 1.1, "model": "en_GB-vctk-medium", "pitch": 0.92, "speaker": "p227"}, {"length": 1.0, "lufs": -18, "noise": 0.667, "pitch": 1.0}, "Ah! My night visitor. Sit. Mind the cat; she bites scholars."]
56d03850ebe7: [5, {"length_scale": 1.1, "model": "en_GB-vctk-medium", "pitch": 0.92, "speaker": "p227"}, {"length": 1.0, "lufs": -18, "noise": 0.667, "pitch": 1.0}, "Or early. It rather depends what you\u2019re looking for."]
677be4ed690e: [5, {"length_scale": 1.0, "model": "en_GB-cori-high"}, {"length": 1.07, "lufs": -18, "noise": 0.6, "pitch": 1.0}, "Quill sets down his pen and draws out a folder sealed with brown wax."]
a8f5c5f4ead5: [5, {"length_scale": 1.1, "model": "en_GB-vctk-medium", "pitch": 0.92, "speaker": "p227"}, {"length": 1.0, "lufs": -18, "noise": 0.667, "pitch": 1.0}, "Hollow Bell. b26a6f0903a4: [5, {"length_scale": 1.1, "model": "en_GB-vctk-medium", "pitch": 0.92, "speaker": "p227"}, {"length": 1.0, "lufs": -18, "noise": 0.667, "pitch": 1.0}, "Beneath the tower lies what we call the Hush. 661aaf126111: [5, {"length_scale": 1.0, "model": "en_GB-cori-high"}, {"length": 1.07, "lufs": -18, "noise": 0.6, "pitch": 1.0}, "He peers at you over the folder."]
544a17547c94: [5, {"length_scale": 1.1, "model": "en_GB-vctk-medium", "pitch": 0.92, "speaker": "p227"}, {"length": 1.0, "lufs": -18, "noise": 0.667, "pitch": 1.0}, "The song was written on two pages. I know where one of them is."]
47fc8941b060: [5, {"length_scale": 1.0, "model": "en_GB-cori-high"}, {"length": 1.0, "lufs": -18, "noise": 0.667, "pitch": 1.0}, "While you leaf innocently through a crate of nineteenth-century accounts, you find a letter from Cantor Vale to the headmaster: The bell will ring itself if the song is forgotten. 88d3bbdf2725: [5, {"length_scale": 1.0, "model": "en_GB-cori-high"}, {"length": 1.0, "lufs": -18, "noise": 0.667, "pitch": 1.0}, "Quill has been standing behind you the entire time."]
a7b815124671: [5, {"length_scale": 1.1, "model": "en_GB-vctk-medium", "pitch": 0.92, "speaker": "p227"}, {"length": 1.0, "lufs": -18, "noise": 0.667, "pitch": 1.0}, "You\u2019re looking for the bell, aren\u2019t you?"]
3b9fac22200a: [5, {"length_scale": 1.1, "model": "en_GB-vctk-medium", "pitch": 0.92, "speaker": "p227"}, {"length": 1.0, "lufs": -18, "noise": 0.667, "pitch": 1.0}, "You look so innocent that you very nearly fooled me."]
877781be6ddf: [5, {"length_scale": 1.0, "model": "en_GB-cori-high"}, {"length": 1.07, "lufs": -18, "noise": 0.6, "pitch": 1.0}, "Quill takes off his spectacles and rubs his eyes."]
65228b7a028a: [5, {"length_scale": 1.1, "model": "en_GB-vctk-medium", "pitch": 0.92, "speaker": "p227"}, {"length": 1.0, "lufs": -18, "noise": 0.667, "pitch": 1.0}, "I wasn\u2019t always an archivist. 981de907ea44: [5, {"length_scale": 1.1, "model": "en_GB-vctk-medium", "pitch": 0.92, "speaker": "p227"}, {"length": 1.0, "lufs": -18, "noise": 0.667, "pitch": 1.0}, "It did the opposite. Since then I have been an archivist, a watchman and a coward, all at once."]
b267e3d0e441: [5, {"length_scale": 1.0, "model": "en_GB-cori-high"}, {"length": 1.07, "lufs": -18, "noise": 0.6, "pitch": 1.0}, "He puts the spectacles back on, and his hands are not quite steady."]
e58e4b499709: [5, {"length_scale": 1.0, "model": "en_GB-cori-high"}, {"length": 1.0, "lufs": -18, "noise": 0.667, "pitch": 1.0}, "Behind Quill the shelves hold a thousand folders, and some are dustier than others."]
dd03605d50c3: [5, {"length_scale": 1.1, "model": "en_GB-vctk-medium", "pitch": 0.92, "speaker": "p227"}, {"length": 1.0, "lufs": -18, "noise": 0.667, "pitch": 1.0}, "I can\u2019t search any more. My eyes aren\u2019t what they were."]
4f2d07351b34: [5, {"length_scale": 1.0, "model": "en_GB-cori-high"}, {"length": 1.07, "lufs": -18, "noise": 0.6, "pitch": 1.0}, "Under a stack of old accounts you find a single page in neat, faded ink: the notes of a lullaby. b148a1d29845: [5, {"length_scale": 1.0, "model": "en_GB-cori-high"}, {"length": 1.07, "lufs": -18, "noise": 0.6, "pitch": 1.0}, "The page is cold in your hand, but you feel it wants something. Quill nods."]
40afa54fbe56: [5, {"length_scale": 1.1, "model": "en_GB-vctk-medium", "pitch": 0.92, "speaker": "p227"}, {"length": 1.0, "lufs": -18, "noise": 0.667, "pitch": 1.0}, "Take it. And for heaven\u2019s sake, don\u2019t lose it."]
f4abf4cc06d4: [5, {"length_scale": 1.0, "model": "en_GB-cori-high"}, {"length": 1.07, "lufs": -18, "noise": 0.6, "pitch": 1.0}, "Quill closes his eyes. For a long moment nothing happens. 70087a67debe: [5, {"length_scale": 1.0, "model": "en_GB-cori-high"}, {"length": 1.07, "lufs": -18, "noise": 0.6, "pitch": 1.0}, "When he finishes he is crying and pretending not to."]

f127346810bc: [5, {"length_scale": 1.1, "model": "en_GB-vctk-medium", "pitch": 0.92, "speaker": "p227"}, {"length": 1.08, "lufs": -23, "noise": 0.55, "pitch": 0.98}, "It\u2019s not the first time something has disappeared from here."]
245b477a22d9: [5, {"length_scale": 1.0, "model": "en_GB-cori-high"}, {"length": 1.07, "lufs": -18, "noise": 0.6, "pitch": 1.0}, "The music room in the east wing has been locked for longer than anyone can say. 5ba498b48c2f: [5, {"length_scale": 1.0, "model": "en_GB-cori-high"}, {"length": 1.07, "lufs": -18, "noise": 0.6, "pitch": 1.0}, "The door swings open on its own. f9e2c452143a: [5, {"fx": "aecho=0.8:0.7:60:0.4", "length_scale": 1.2, "model": "en_GB-vctk-medium", "pitch": 0.9, "speaker": "p232"}, {"length": 1.0, "lufs": -18, "noise": 0.667, "pitch": 1.0}, "No one has knocked here in a very long time,"]
3d9e2ca46eb8: [5, {"length_scale": 1.0, "model": "en_GB-cori-high"}, {"length": 1.07, "lufs": -18, "noise": 0.6, "pitch": 1.0}, "he says, and his voice carries a strange harmonic, as though two people are speaking."]
0d0d6c32a988: [5, {"fx": "aecho=0.8:0.7:60:0.4", "length_scale": 1.2, "model": "en_GB-vctk-medium", "pitch": 0.9, "speaker": "p232"}, {"length": 1.0, "lufs": -18, "noise": 0.667, "pitch": 1.0}, "You are kind. Come in. I am Eadric Vale."]
2bfa3db855e7: [5, {"length_scale": 1.0, "model": "en_GB-cori-high"}, {"length": 1.07, "lufs": -18, "noise": 0.6, "pitch": 1.0}, "The door splinters on its hinges, and cold pours out of the room. In the middle of it a transparent figure shoots up toward the ceiling, shrieking without sound."]
e6a06ff811c3: [5, {"length_scale": 1.0, "model": "en_GB-cori-high"}, {"length": 1.07, "lufs": -18, "noise": 0.6, "pitch": 1.0}, "You have cast a bell of black metal and written a song on two pages. You know it will work. You do not yet know what it will cost."]
b164ac75bc6b: [5, {"length_scale": 1.0, "model": "en_GB-cori-high"}, {"length": 1.07, "lufs": -18, "noise": 0.6, "pitch": 1.0}, "You blink, and the music room is back. Vale stands before you, and in his eyes you can see that he knows what you have seen."]
8a8fe543a226: [5, {"length_scale": 1.0, "model": "en_GB-cori-high"}, {"length": 1.07, "lufs": -18, "noise": 0.6, "pitch": 1.0}, "Vale speaks softly. Then someone broke in and took half of the notes. Ever since, he has not been able to sing alone."]
70278a8ae6b4: [5, {"length_scale": 1.0, "model": "en_GB-cori-high"}, {"length": 1.0, "lufs": -18, "noise": 0.667, "pitch": 1.0}, "Through the keyhole you see a tidy desk, a glass cabinet of silver instruments, and an open book."]
9cf86119865a: [5, {"length_scale": 1.0, "model": "en_GB-northern_english_male-medium"}, {"length": 1.0, "lufs": -18, "noise": 0.667, "pitch": 1.0}, "My sister Lenora climbed Hollow Tower when she was twelve, to prove she was brave. She fell asleep up there. She never woke."]

483a02843e7a: [5, {"length_scale": 1.0, "model": "en_GB-cori-high"}, {"length": 1.0, "lufs": -18, "noise": 0.667, "pitch": 1.0}, "You tuck the ledger under your cloak and are gone before anyone comes."]
efee48032e0e: [5, {"length_scale": 1.0, "model": "en_GB-cori-high"}, {"length": 1.0, "lufs": -18, "noise": 0.667, "pitch": 1.0}, "Outside the staff room you hear Mirela\u2019s voice, hard and controlled."]
a2b337d61921: [5, {"length_scale": 1.0, "model": "en_GB-cori-high"}, {"length": 1.0, "lufs": -18, "noise": 0.667, "pitch": 1.0}, "You are the only one who sees them."]
434f4baeeb11: [5, {"length_scale": 1.1, "model": "en_GB-vctk-medium", "pitch": 0.92, "speaker": "p227"}, {"length": 1.0, "lufs": -18, "noise": 0.667, "pitch": 1.0}, "Give this to Corvin. He will understand."]
e6bde33bcac4: [5, {"length_scale": 1.0, "model": "en_GB-cori-high"}, {"length": 1.0, "lufs": -18, "noise": 0.667, "pitch": 1.0}, "Pip lies as he did last night: calm, cold, far away. On the bedside table sit a half-eaten chocolate frog and an unopened letter from his mother."]
4be2cf961d03: [5, {"length_scale": 0.95, "model": "en_GB-jenny_dioco-medium"}, {"length": 1.08, "lufs": -23, "noise": 0.55, "pitch": 0.98}, "What do we do if Ashgrove is up there?"]
230dbddf5bf2: [5, {"length_scale": 1.0, "model": "en_GB-cori-high"}, {"length": 1.07, "lufs": -18, "noise": 0.6, "pitch": 1.0}, "Kringer has to get up the stairs. Your job is to hold it back. The notebook shakes in your hand."]
603365722543: [5, {"length_scale": 1.0, "model": "en_GB-cori-high"}, {"length": 1.07, "lufs": -18, "noise": 0.6, "pitch": 1.0}, "The last thing you feel is the floor against your cheek. Then it goes very, very quiet."]
63d1a27ecd45: [5, {"length_scale": 1.0, "model": "en_GB-cori-high"}, {"length": 1.07, "lufs": -18, "noise": 0.6, "pitch": 1.0}, "You hold on to the memory of sitting beside Pip, the warmth of his hand. It is something to keep hold of."]
9eec1934e2ef: [5, {"length_scale": 1.0, "model": "en_GB-cori-high"}, {"length": 1.07, "lufs": -18, "noise": 0.6, "pitch": 1.0}, "Professor Ashgrove stands by the ropes. He does not look surprised. db1dbea8fa0e: [5, {"length_scale": 1.0, "model": "en_GB-cori-high"}, {"length": 1.0, "lufs": -18, "noise": 0.667, "pitch": 1.0}, "He does not look at you as an enemy. He looks at you as someone who could stop him, and whom he hopes will not."]
76e0bc83c1c9: [5, {"length_scale": 1.0, "model": "en_GB-northern_english_male-medium"}, {"length": 1.0, "lufs": -18, "noise": 0.667, "pitch": 1.0}, "I have been set on this for ten years,"]
04a69ce6465f: [5, {"length_scale": 1.0, "model": "en_GB-cori-high"}, {"length": 1.07, "lufs": -18, "noise": 0.6, "pitch": 1.0}, "From inside his coat Ashgrove takes a folded sheet, brittle at the creases."]
6f0a6441f764: [5, {"length_scale": 1.0, "model": "en_GB-cori-high"}, {"length": 1.07, "lufs": -18, "noise": 0.6, "pitch": 1.0}, "Eadric Vale drifts out of the bell\u2019s shadow."]
769cda097d84: [5, {"length_scale": 1.0, "model": "en_GB-cori-high"}, {"length": 1.07, "lufs": -18, "noise": 0.6, "pitch": 1.0}, "Beneath you the Hush turns in its sleep and sinks deeper. And for the first time in two days a real light comes through the windows: dawn."]
4a629f34b4bc: [5, {"length_scale": 1.0, "model": "en_GB-vctk-medium", "pitch": 1.06, "speaker": "p258"}, {"length": 1.0, "lufs": -18, "noise": 0.667, "pitch": 1.0}, "I heard you. You said my name."]
50bdb0d87d4e: [5, {"length_scale": 1.0, "model": "en_GB-cori-high"}, {"length": 1.0, "lufs": -18, "noise": 0.667, "pitch": 1.0}, "Mirela stands at the tower door with tears in her eyes and a notebook torn in half. She smiles anyway."]
a58fbecce265: [5, {"length_scale": 1.0, "model": "en_GB-cori-high"}, {"length": 1.07, "lufs": -18, "noise": 0.6, "pitch": 1.0}, "He says he dreamed someone sat beside him, and that it was warm."]
d3f5bb18410d: [5, {"length_scale": 1.0, "model": "en_GB-cori-high"}, {"length": 1.07, "lufs": -18, "noise": 0.6, "pitch": 1.0}, "Vale sings from memory. His voice is weaker than you expected, but it is true. The bell answers, and with every note he grows a little more transparent."]
db31062c12b1: [5, {"length_scale": 1.0, "model": "en_GB-cori-high"}, {"length": 1.07, "lufs": -18, "noise": 0.6, "pitch": 1.0}, "Ashgrove sits in the tower long afterwards. He says nothing, but you see that he is weeping."]
a7cda53f07dc: [5, {"length_scale": 1.0, "model": "en_GB-cori-high"}, {"length": 1.07, "lufs": -18, "noise": 0.6, "pitch": 1.0}, "The students wake that night, every one, in a castle evacuated before dawn. Hogwarts is closed for months."]
251b97e71793: [5, {"length_scale": 1.0, "model": "en_GB-cori-high"}, {"length": 1.07, "lufs": -18, "noise": 0.6, "pitch": 1.0}, "she says. Then she looks down into the hole in the floor, and the smile fades."]
